doors.title: BOLT & SPROCKET
doors.desc: A junkyard mechanic, a robot with opinions and a ship the bank wants back. Planet-hop, blast repo bots, smash things with a mallet and keep up the payments.

doors.title: CLAUDE ZOMBIES
doors.desc: The squad came back from Basel three months early. The dead are already here. Survive the rounds, power the station and find out who signed for this.

doors.title: THE FINE PRINT

doors.title: THE ARCHIVE
doors.desc: Every memo, transmission and document you've recovered across all three stories, in one filing cabinet.
